verdict.rationale: Sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times into an email is a fair question for an email-and-calendar client like Outlook, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents the capability. The closest item, getting or updating a user's working hours via Graph, is an adjacent setting, not a way to insert availability into a message.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
